metadata.description: TCM monitoring template aligned with CISA SCuBA baseline for Microsoft Teams. Covers external access, meeting policies, and messaging policies.
metadata.license: Portions adapted from CISA SCuBA SCBs (TLP:CLEAR). See URL for full license terms.

controls.title: External access for Teams and Skype users SHALL only be enabled on a per-domain basis
controls.guidance: External access (federation) SHALL be restricted to specific allowed domains rather than open to all. TCM monitors FederationConfiguration for drift that may re-open federation.

controls.title: External access SHALL be restricted to only authorized domains
controls.guidance: The allowed external domain list SHALL contain only agency-approved domains. TCM monitors for unauthorized domain additions to federation settings.

controls.title: Unmanaged users SHALL NOT be enabled to initiate contact
controls.guidance: Contact with unmanaged (non-organizational) Teams users SHALL be disabled. TCM monitors FederationConfiguration for changes to unmanaged user access.

controls.title: Internal users SHOULD NOT be able to chat with Skype users
controls.guidance: Skype interop SHOULD be disabled as Skype consumer is being retired. TCM monitors FederationConfiguration for Skype access changes.

controls.title: Anonymous users SHALL NOT be enabled to start meetings
controls.guidance: Meeting policies SHALL prevent anonymous users from starting meetings. TCM monitors MeetingPolicy for drift on anonymous user settings.

controls.title: Anonymous users SHOULD NOT be admitted automatically to meetings
controls.guidance: Lobby settings SHOULD require anonymous users to wait. TCM monitors MeetingPolicy AutoAdmittedUsers property for drift.

controls.title: External participants SHOULD NOT be given control in meetings
controls.guidance: Meeting policies SHOULD prevent external participants from sharing their screen or requesting control. TCM monitors MeetingPolicy for screen sharing and control settings.

controls.title: Only approved apps SHOULD be allowed in Teams
controls.guidance: App permission policies SHOULD restrict which apps can be installed. TCM monitors AppPermissionPolicy for drift that may allow unauthorized apps.

controls.title: Users SHOULD be able to report security concerns in Teams
controls.guidance: Messaging policies SHOULD enable reporting of suspicious messages. TCM monitors MessagingPolicy for drift on reporting settings.
